boundary.description: From the point where the railway crosses Crossley Road, S along the railway to and W along Heaton Road, Alexandra Road, Green Lane, by a footpath across Bowerfold Open Space to Green Lane , through M60 junction 1 to River Mersey. W along the river to and to the point where the railway crosses Cossley Road.
